evidence_records.relevance_summary: Randomized phase III evidence supports this 21-day eribulin schedule in the studied advanced-breast population; median overall survival was 13.1 versus 10.6 months against physician's-choice treatment (HR 0.81, 95% CI 0.66-0.99).
key_findings: Randomized phase III evidence supports this 21-day eribulin schedule in the studied advanced-breast population; median overall survival was 13.1 versus 10.6 months against physician's-choice treatment (HR 0.81, 95% CI 0.66-0.99).
evidence_records.limitations: Population-level historical trial results are not an individual prognosis, do not establish benefit in every line/subtype, and must not be copied to the 28-day schedule or liposarcoma. Trials report 1.4 mg/m² eribulin mesylate; the Irish/EU product dose is expressed as 1.23 mg/m² eribulin base. Never substitute the numeric dose expression without checking formulation.
